Proactive messages rely on a background process. Chinese ROMs clear background apps by default; after whitelisting per the steps below, you\'ll keep receiving messages even after swiping the app away:
Official ChatGPT export (the zip in your email, or the extracted conversations.json)
1. Open ChatGPT → Settings → Profile → Data controls
2. Tap "Export data"; OpenAI emails you a zip
3. Download the zip to your phone, or extract it and pick conversations.json
4. Select the file in Muse and the conversations are imported automatically
